notes:
Development build of Tally for Windows, for direct distribution. Not a store build.

Built with the legacy (unprofiled) build path while the profiled pilot is checked. Backend: none. Catalog: https://staging-catalog.g3tech.net. Payments/licenses: https://staging-pay.g3tech.net.

Includes the shared g3-brand updater fix (800a257): installing an update from Tally now waits for the installer to take over before the app exits, so the update runs and Tally reopens.

- chore(release): tally 0.1.4 (53e5bf8)
- feat: snappy UI on big books, account sections and hidden accounts (1ce8d5d)
